# Ascleon

> AI study companion for medical students. Study medical lectures and textbooks side-by-side with a live bilingual voice mentor, diagnostic roadmaps, physiology simulators, and case-based medical QBanks.

## Overview

Ascleon helps medical students master dense lectures and textbooks by combining an interactive PDF reader with a real-time bilingual (English and Arabic) AI voice mentor, structured clinical diagnostic roadmaps, interactive physiology simulators, and USMLE-style case-based question banks.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://www.ascleon.app): Overview of Ascleon and its medical study workflow.
- [Library](https://www.ascleon.app/library): Browse and open medical textbooks and lecture materials.
- [Subscriptions](https://www.ascleon.app/subscriptions): Available plans and features.
